Cox Automotive is hiring an entry-level Software Engineer to help design and deliver scalable software products for automotive customers. The role contributes to a scrum team by building, deploying, monitoring, and managing production systems and collaborating on code quality and engineering improvements.

Marketing

Digital Marketing
No H1B
Responsibilities
Be a passionate and flexible engineer, collaborate with your team to achieve and exceed the goal to build, deploy, monitor, and manage a highly performing and highly available production system
Write readable, maintainable, and efficient code
Collaborate with team members on best practices, code reviews, internal tools and process improvements
Evangelize new ideas within your team
Explore open source or industry standard solutions that could be a fit for the organization

High energy, confident, ambitious, and self-motivated individual
Must be an effective communicator
Able to work in fast-paced environments

Preferred

Benefits
May be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.
Hybrid - Ability to work remotely part of the week
Time during working hours to volunteer at local charities.
Eligible employees may take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company’s needs, and its obligations.
Seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year.
Up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for employees’ own wellness or that of family members.
Additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.
Benefits of working at Cox may include health care insurance (medical, dental, vision), retirement planning (401(k)), and paid days off (sick leave, parental leave, flexible vacation/wellness days, and/or PTO).
